modifiers.note: Temporal Scaffolding (manor.tactics): each Manor has an AutoRangedModify BuildRate x1.25 aura, range 20, on unbuilt buildings. Several Manors stack additively (+25% each): measured 16.7/13.3/11.1/9.5 s for a Counter Barracks with 0-3 Manors; confirmed as intended on the official forum.

meta.note: Power: Deconstruction (cooldown 180). Not expressed as modifiers: Time Shift of own buildings (major_gods.xml timeshifting, see power 'time-shift'); lost siege weapons (wood, gold) and myth units (all resources incl. favor) refund 20% (ResourceReturnRate 0.20; not Promethean Offspring). Age up: KronosExtra<Unit> techs create 1 more myth unit at the Temple on top of the minor god's 1, so 2 in total for every Kronos minor god.
